title: One-Hot Encoding of Nominal Values
prompt: Write a Python function to perform one-hot encoding of nominal values. The function should take in a 1D numpy array x of integer values and an optional integer n_col representing the number of columns for the one-hot encoded array. If n_col is not provided, it should be automatically determined from the input array.
